Here is a curated playlist for your warm summer afternoon backyard barbecue, blending upbeat country and reggae to keep the vibe laid-back and social:

1. "Watermelon Sugar" - Harry Styles (Reggae-infused pop)
2. "Chicken Fried" - Zac Brown Band
3. "Three Little Birds" - Bob Marley & The Wailers
4. "Body Like a Back Road" - Sam Hunt
5. "Is This Love" - Bob Marley & The Wailers
6. "Tennessee Whiskey" - Chris Stapleton
7. "Jamming" - Bob Marley & The Wailers
8. "Die a Happy Man" - Thomas Rhett
9. "No Woman, No Cry" - Bob Marley & The Wailers

Enjoy your barbecue and the great company!
